source_feature.source_crs: EPSG:4326 response; service geometry is campus GIS, project-local coordinates use project equirectangular approximation
source_feature.method: Converted all WGS84 ring vertices through project transform; retained full polygon and centered local geometry at its bounds center
source_feature.area_discrepancy_note: GIS Shape__Area reports 8918.01 while the project local transform ring area is 5158.85 m2; metric agreement not assumed pending review of source area units/projection.

area_reconciliation.result: Resolved projection difference; the footprint identity is consistent across the two cached Purdue GIS snapshots.
area_reconciliation.feature_match: Both snapshots contain one FID 273 / PHYS polygon with the same single 34-vertex EPSG:4326 ring; every coordinate matches.
area_reconciliation.calculation: Project local ring shoelace area is 5158.8513 m². Purdue Shape__Area is 8918.0078 m² in the underlying Web Mercator service plane. At centroid latitude 40.4300°, 8918.0078*cos(latitude)^2 = 5167.30 m², within 0.17% of the locally transformed ring. This is the expected Web Mercator area scale distortion (sec(latitude)^2), plus small projection / rounding differences; it is not a second footprint or omitted ring.
area_reconciliation.source_crs_detail: Service-native EPSG:3857/102100 Shape__Area is planar Web Mercator area; API response coordinates were requested in EPSG:4326. Project local coordinates use the project equirectangular approximation.
area_reconciliation.geometry_review: GIS source has one exterior ring and no additional hole/disjoint rings. Shape is unchanged in this revision.

geometry_edits: Created the building library asset from Purdue GIS FID 273 and preserved its local project coordinate frame and wall footprint.
Extruded the exact GIS outline to an estimated 12.20 m main wall line; retained the approximately three-story visible envelope.
Rebuilt the low hipped roof from the same GIS outline at the GIS R-field roof datum estimate of 15.92 m; applied meter-scale red-clay tile UVs oriented to the GIS long axis and one aligned ridge cap.

Added repeated dark sash bays, running-bond procedural brick, pale limestone story belts/cornice, and a small basement sash tier based on official Purdue photographs; opening count and dimensions remain estimates.
Placed a centered light-stone PHYSICS panel and three glazed entrance bays on the photo-supported NW Avenue facade; retained the secondary arched entrance on the other elevation.
Retained schematic entry vestibule/interior cues and the GIS-aligned MSEE skybridge; detailed floor-by-floor interior and exact bridge superstructure remain incomplete or interpretive.
R2: Refined exterior sash proportions toward the taller photographic window ratio and added raised charcoal perimeter frames, central meeting stiles, and horizontal sash rails on facade windows.
R2: Added a layered shadow fascia and projecting pale-stone eave moulding, engaged pilasters at the three-door entrance, door glazing divisions, and sign-panel corner details.

R2: Added inset ground/first/second visible-floor plates and level-separated schematic corridor/room partitions guided by Purdue evacuation-plan functions; no room dimension or exact partition placement is claimed as surveyed.

R2: Added a review-only Northwestern Avenue sidewalk, curb, roadway, lawn, low hedges, and fence to improve scale and frontage context in the exterior preview; these context objects are not part of the library asset.

validation.uncertainty: The GIS wall footprint and campus origin remain verified. Exterior window, cornice and entry detail follows official photos; detailed story heights, roof pitch, basement window size/count, and internal room dimensions remain estimates. Interior corridors/functions follow official plans schematically; preview landscaping/context is render-only.
validation.reopen_check: Blender 5.2.3 loaded the saved asset in a fresh process. Verified 319 collection objects, 317 materialized meshes, no missing external images, bounds, and bidirectional GIS footprint vertex agreement within 0.00000054 m.
validation.footprint_note: GIS envelope base vertices retained; facade relief/details are additive. Roof rebuilt from the same GIS footprint ring; no XY footprint edits.

notes: Compared the same FID 273 one-ring, 34-vertex footprint in two Purdue GIS snapshots and documented the Web Mercator/project-frame area reconciliation.
Rebuilt the central portal, prominent PHYSICS sign, arched upper window and fanlight divisions; relocated/rebuilt the source skybridge to align its ends with the nearest PHYS/MSEE GIS wall points.
Saved the calculated MSEE-aligned source-local/master-coordinate endpoint transform in the evidence report; master placements are unchanged and span/height remain estimated.

Added a warm schematic vestibule cue behind the glazed entry, plus a short entry walk and paired low planters. Interior room layout, site furniture, and planting placement are interpretive, not survey-derived.
Corrected the principal NW Avenue frontage to have three glazed entrance bays with a legible PHYSICS inscription on a light-stone panel; retained the secondary arched entrance on the other elevation.
Added a running-bond procedural brick pattern, small basement sash tier, and more legible pale horizontal stone bands along the primary street facade.

Rebuilt the roof surface across the exact GIS outline, applied GIS-axis-aligned meter-scale clay tile UVs, and replaced three offset ridge bars with one centered ridge cap aligned to the GIS long axis.
Rendered review previews after a fresh Blender reopen. Temporary area lights and camera placements used for previews only; not saved into the asset.
R2: Added tall charcoal divided sash frames, a more legible eave shadow fascia/limestone crown, entrance pilasters and refined door/transom muntins based on Purdue facade photographs.

R2: Added inset floor plates and separate ground/first/second floor circulation partitions guided by Purdue’s official evacuation floor plans. Exact interior dimensions/partition placements remain schematic.
R2: Rendered exterior with Northwestern Avenue sidewalk, curb, roadway, lawn, hedges and fence plus a close entrance/roof view; all review-only context and lighting remain outside the modular asset.
R2: Reopened and independently checked the GIS footprint; maximum nearest-vertex deviation remains below 0.000001 m in both directions.
